title: RATE ≠ STRATEGY. But a Better Rate Can Reopen the Conversation.
subtitle: Tap into improved rate conditions to reconnect with potential clients and unlock new opportunities. Use UFF's tools to re-engage effectively.
keyTakeaways: Revisit clients who previously paused due to high rates.
Utilize PRO Portal to price and rerun scenarios with updated rates.
Stay proactive with changing market conditions.
Leverage rate changes to restart client conversations.
Demonstrate value by providing timely market insights.

sections.heading: Seize New Opportunities with Improved Rates
sections.body: As rates improve, now is the perfect time to reconnect with borrowers who found previous conditions unaffordable. This isn't about waiting for the perfect rate; it's about recognizing and acting on a better opportunity.
bullets: Identify clients who were close to approval thresholds.
Use improved rates as a conversation starter.

sections.heading: Strategically Use PRO Portal
sections.body: Leverage the UFF PRO Portal to effectively manage and reprice client scenarios. With real-time rate updates and comprehensive loan management tools, ensure you’re providing timely and accurate information.
bullets: Reprice scenarios with live rate updates.
Rerun calculations and adjust client expectations.

sections.heading: Demonstrate Value and Build Trust
sections.body: Showing your clients you’re proactive and informed can strengthen relationships. Provide insights on market movements and help clients navigate their options with confidence.
bullets: Communicate the potential impact of upcoming market data.
Explain the benefits of acting with current rates.

metaDescription: Encourage brokers to revisit clients as rates improve. Re-engage with UFF's PRO Portal for new opportunities.
